verdict.rationale: Daytona exposes a published OpenAPI spec and official TypeScript, Python, Go and Ruby SDKs, plus a CLI and an MCP server. The documented features (sandbox lifecycle, snapshots, volumes, firewall settings updatable at runtime, code execution, computer use) are all described as programmatically controllable. Browser web-terminal tasks such as running commands and viewing files have SDK and SSH equivalents. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement or feature matrix confirming UI–API parity (e.g., account, billing and org admin via API), and independent hands-on corroboration that no feature is UI-only.
